description:
Everything SharpSyn publishes about one compound, given its CAS number,
    InChIKey or name: identifiers, structure (SMILES, InChI), number of verified
    suppliers with regions, grades and lead times, price range per kg with its
    confidence label and data date, the cradle-to-gate carbon footprint with
    tier, source and uncertainty, and the page URL to cite. If the compound has
    no public page, says so and gives a link where the user can still ask
    suppliers for it.
name: get_compound
